# asset-library-plan (reference summary)

## Purpose
Plan an internal asset library structure (folders, naming, metadata, license tracking, version control) so future recipes find and reuse assets reliably.

Plan a maintainable internal asset library structure (folder tree, naming convention, per-asset metadata schema, license-tracking strategy, version-control rules, migration steps, and review process) so future recipes can: - find existing assets quickly, - avoid re-licensing the same source, - reuse PBR materials and HDRIs, - track versions and revisions, - serve as the internal-library source for `asset-discovery` and `asset-fallback-strategy`.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/asset-library-plan/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/asset-library-plan/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `asset-and-sourcing` / `local-asset-library-taxonomy-planner`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- starting a new BlendOps repo with multiple recipes
- existing library is disorganized; recipes can't find assets
- before scaling to 50+ assets

## Trigger cues
- "organize the assets"
- "asset library structure"
- "where should assets go"
- "name our assets"

## When not to use
- single-recipe repo with < 5 assets → delegate to `asset-discovery` (`references/skills/asset-discovery.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to asset-discovery)
- pure planning before any asset categories or storage constraints are known → delegate to `asset-license-checker` (`references/skills/asset-license-checker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to asset-license-checker)
- sourcing or acquiring external assets → delegate to `asset-discovery` (`references/skills/asset-discovery.md`; use asset-discovery)
- verifying asset licenses → delegate to `asset-license-checker` (`references/skills/asset-license-checker.md`; use asset-license-checker)
- checking visual style consistency across assets → delegate to `asset-style-check` (`references/skills/asset-style-check.md`; use asset-style-check)
- planning fallback substitutions when an asset is missing or fails → delegate to `asset-fallback-strategy` (`references/skills/asset-fallback-strategy.md`; use asset-fallback-strategy)
- enforcing file size or polygon/asset count performance budgets → delegate to `mobile-glb-budget` (`references/skills/mobile-glb-budget.md`; use mobile-glb-budget)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `raw_asset_inventory` (`array`): List of 3D models, PBR material sets, HDRIs, and license sidecar files to organize
- `project_storage_scope` (`string`): Whether the library is project-local or shared across multiple BlendOps packs

### Optional inputs
- `naming_prefix_convention` (`string`): Optional studio or project naming prefix for datablocks and folders

### Primary outputs
- `directory_taxonomy_plan`
- `datablock_naming_rules`
- `quarantine_and_license_sidecar_policy`

## Quick-start procedure
1. pin folder structure (kebab-case, by category)
2. pin naming convention (asset name + version + license slug)
3. pin metadata schema (license, source, date, version, hash)
4. pin version control rules (LFS for large binaries, plain text for metadata)
5. emit a library-init plan

## Handoff notes
- **[upstream_reference]** External asset sourcing into this library → `asset-discovery` (`references/skills/asset-discovery.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; assets.discoveryComplete equals false]`
- **[upstream_reference]** License verification (license file next to asset; unlicensed old assets to Quarantine) → `asset-license-checker` (`references/skills/asset-license-checker.md`) — `when.all: [assets.externalUsed equals true; assets.licenseCleared equals false]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Visual style consistency checks → `asset-style-check` (`references/skills/asset-style-check.md`) — `when.all: [assets.licenseCleared equals true; stage.current equals "style_check"]`
- **[fallback]** Consuming this library as fastest fallback source → `asset-fallback-strategy` (`references/skills/asset-fallback-strategy.md`) — `when.all: [assets.fallbackNeeded equals true]`
- **[progression]** File size and asset/polygon count pressure → `mobile-glb-budget` (`references/skills/mobile-glb-budget.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.type equals "glb"; budget.pinned equals false]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Planning skill — never moves files, never configures git/LFS/DAM, never runs Blender, and never produces library files. Outputs a structure spec, migration steps, and review process only.
- Move, rename, or delete files.
- Configure git, Git LFS, Perforce, or DAM tools.
- Run Blender or execute Python.
- Buy or source external assets (use `asset-discovery`).
- Verify licenses, style consistency, or performance budgets (use `asset-license-checker`, `asset-style-check`, `mobile-glb-budget`).
